A [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] '''supply ship''' participated in the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]<ref name="Plan of Dissent" /> around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Annual" /> Commanded by a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Umbara)|Tactical droid]], it was used to supply the [[Umbaran militia]] with large [[Missile/Legends|missiles]].<ref name="Plan of Dissent" /> The [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel/Legends|Separatist supply ship]] was used as a heavy [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and was 908.78 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, 1257.32 meters wide, and 910.35 meters high, and was defended by [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> During the Battle of Umbara, [[Umbaran support ship/Legends|Umbaran support ships]] and other Separatist [[Warship/Legends|warships]] provided protection. [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 1 (Umbara)|Three]] [[Unidentified B1-series battle droid (Umbara)/Legends|B1 battle droids]] worked in the vessel's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. The supply ship was infiltrated by three [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] flying captured [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighters]]. One of which, [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]], sacrificed himself to destroy the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]], which resulted in a chain-reaction and the destruction of the vessel.<ref name="Plan of Dissent">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The supply ship appeared in ''[[Plan of Dissent]]'', an episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Four]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.
